SUPPLY AGREEMENT NO. SC-2023-001
Date: January 15, 2023

PARTIES:
Buyer: Freeport Cobalt ("Buyer"), registered in DR Congo (COD)
Supplier: Congo Cobalt Mines ("Supplier"), registered in DR Congo (COD)

RECITALS:
WHEREAS, Supplier is engaged in the mining and processing of cobalt ore and cobalt-based products in the Democratic Republic of Congo; and
WHEREAS, Buyer requires a consistent supply of high-purity cobalt for downstream battery material processing and refining operations;

NOW, THEREFORE, the parties agree as follows:

1. PRODUCT SPECIFICATIONS
   - Product: Cobalt and Cobalt Products (HS Code 8106.00)
   - Minimum Purity: 99.5% Co content
   - Form: Cobalt cathodes and cobalt hydroxide
   - Annual Volume: 500,000 kg minimum, 750,000 kg maximum

2. DELIVERY TERMS
   - Port of Origin: Port of Dar es Salaam
   - Delivery Schedule: Monthly shipments of approximately 42,000 kg
   - Incoterms: FOB Port of Dar es Salaam
   - Lead Time: 30 days from purchase order confirmation

3. PRICING
   - Base Price: USD 58.50 per kg, subject to London Metal Exchange (LME) cobalt price adjustments
   - Price Review: Quarterly, based on LME 3-month average
   - Total Estimated Annual Contract Value: USD 29,250,000

4. QUALITY ASSURANCE
   - All shipments must include Certificate of Analysis (CoA)
   - Independent assay verification at port of loading
   - Buyer reserves right to reject shipments below 99.3% purity threshold

5. FORCE MAJEURE AND RISK PROVISIONS
   - Given the high geopolitical risk score (0.8) associated with the DR Congo region, the following additional provisions apply:
   - Supplier shall maintain a 60-day buffer stock at the Port of Dar es Salaam
   - In the event of civil unrest, armed conflict, or government intervention affecting mining operations, Supplier shall provide 14-day advance notice where possible
   - Infrastructure risk mitigation: Supplier shall maintain alternative transportation routes to port facilities given the region's low infrastructure score (0.3)
   - Natural disaster provisions per standard industry terms apply

6. SUPPLY CHAIN CONTINUITY
   - Congo Cobalt Mines has been identified as a critical single point of failure for 47 dependent downstream components
   - Supplier agrees to participate in quarterly supply chain resilience reviews
   - Supplier shall disclose any material changes to production capacity within 5 business days
   - Buyer may request independent audits of Supplier's operational continuity plans

7. COMPLIANCE AND SUSTAINABILITY
   - Supplier warrants compliance with OECD Due Diligence Guidance for Responsible Supply Chains of Minerals from Conflict-Affected and High-Risk Areas
   - All cobalt shall be sourced from artisanal and small-scale mining (ASM) operations that meet Responsible Minerals Initiative (RMI) standards
   - Supplier shall provide chain of custody documentation for each shipment

8. TERM AND TERMINATION
   - Initial Term: 3 years from date of execution
   - Renewal: Automatic renewal for successive 1-year terms unless terminated with 180 days written notice
   - Early Termination: Either party may terminate with 90 days notice for material breach
